subject: Cinderbridge executive intro + demo scheduling — runbook and handshake

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>

Subject: Intro + demo request — Redwood overview for Cinderbridge

Hi Samir / Leah,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — great alignment on the use case. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a short executive briefing + technical demo next week to make sure the right stakeholders see the product before procurement engages. High-level ask: a 45-minute slot with the CIO or VP of Engineering present if possible; CTO can cover the deep technical walkthrough.

Proposed structure (flexible):
- 10 min exec intro (value, risks, & commitment ask) — VP/CIO + Priya/Ben
- 25 min product demo (CTO + technical buyers) — Marissa + product engineer
- 10 min next steps / procurement primer — Priya/Ben

Windows we have available (PST):
- Tuesday 2027-08-03 10:00–10:45
- Wednesday 2027-08-04 14:00–14:45
- Thursday 2027-08-05 09:30–10:15 (tight)

Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Does Cinderbridge need an NDA in advance? If so I can trigger DocuSign and attach a one-page MSA summary.
2) Any security/compliance artifacts you want up-front (SOC 2 cover sheet, data residency note)?

I've attached a short deck and an internal runbook so you can see the proposed flow. If the CIO / VP can't make the full 45, we'll propose a 30-min CTO-led session with a follow-up 15–20 min exec sync.

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.n@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

- Tue 2027-08-03 10:00–10:30 — CTO-led demo + short exec intro (30 min)
- Wed 2027-08-04 16:00–16:20 — VP brief (20 min, optional, exec-only)

If you can send an NDA link and the runbook updated for a 30/20 split, I can confirm invites.

—Samir

- Run a 30-minute CTO-first demo (Leah + team). Keep it tightly scoped to throughput, latency, and deployment modes — those are the win themes.
- Immediately follow (same day or next day) with a 20-minute exec executive brief with the VP (value, cost economics, SLA ask). Priya/Ben should lead the exec sync.
- Offer a brief recording + a 15-min live Q&A slot for the execs in case they want follow-up.

Marissa — can you shorten the runbook to a 30/20 flow and:
- Flag 3 slides for the exec brief (cost, reliability, migration path)
- Add a one-line recording consent in the calendar invite

If we have DocuSign NDA, send it now and ask SalesOps to queue procurement details.
